### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **6** documentable anchor(s).

**25** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c6b37cd08d0eb622d4f59b79effdc954f86dad9f`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c6b37cd08d0eb622d4f59b79effdc954f86dad9f` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `ee85ff77d35feb3a6577fb640d7c0a64ea80eeb3` — the merge of head `3fa342501bc9fb46dfa19c738451027fbb820b61` into base `c6b37cd08d0eb622d4f59b79effdc954f86dad9f`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin ee85ff77d35feb3a6577fb640d7c0a64ea80eeb3 && git checkout ee85ff77d35feb3a6577fb640d7c0a64ea80eeb3
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c6b37cd08d0eb622d4f59b79effdc954f86dad9f 3fa342501bc9fb46dfa19c738451027fbb820b61 && git checkout -B drift-repro c6b37cd08d0eb622d4f59b79effdc954f86dad9f && git merge --no-ff 3fa342501bc9fb46dfa19c738451027fbb820b61

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c6b37cd08d0eb622d4f59b79effdc954f86dad9f
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs c6b37cd08d0eb622d4f59b79effdc954f86dad9f` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `3fa342501bc9fb46dfa19c738451027fbb820b61`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #20539 (body and its 3 comments: triage 5882208447, Claim 5890841958, os-dev-report 5891725468); PR #20652 body and file list (4 files, +46 / -19); the net diff of the branch against `origin/main` (merge-base `cd901d7a5`, `origin/main` at `c6b37cd08` when read); the check-runs on the head. Read-only: nothing built, run or re-run; the `en` values below are `git show origin/main:` reads.

Check-runs on the head at 2026-09-29T14:02Z: 32 runs — 18 success, 3 skipped (Console Pin Gate, Build Docs, Packed-tarball smoke), 11 in_progress (Lint and Repo Gates, Test Core 1-6 of 6, Type Check workspace, Type Check consumer gates, Temporal Conformance, the Dogfood Regression Gate aggregate), 0 failure. Recorded as read, not polled.

### ① Derived judgments

1. Public surface: string VALUES only, inside the three exported translation constants (`jaJPObjects`, `esESObjects`, `zhCNObjects`) of `@objectstack/platform-objects`. No key added or dropped, no type change, no `en` edit, no `*.source-hashes*` companion or echo-decision ledger change, no test change. Accept-set: unchanged — nothing an author can write moves. Right.
2. Each of the 19 re-translated values, judged against the CURRENT `en` value of the same key on `origin/main`:
   - `sys_two_factor.fields.backup_codes.help` (ja-JP, es-ES, zh-CN): `en` reads "Backup recovery codes, encrypted at rest (a single opaque ciphertext, not readable JSON)". All three now say exactly that — encrypted at rest, a single opaque ciphertext, not readable JSON. Right.
   - `sys_notification.description` (all three): `en` reads "Notification events — one row per emit() (ADR-0030 Layer 2 ingress)". All three say that. Right.
   - `sys_job_run.description` (all three): `en` reads "Background job execution history" (`ca19ee81f` replaced "audit trail" with "history", verified in that commit's diff). All three now say history, none says audit. Right.
   - `sys_metadata.fields.environment_id.label` (all three): `en` reads "Environment (deprecated)". All three now say Environment (deprecated); each locale's sibling `help` already said deprecated. Right.
   - es-ES `sys_business_unit.fields.manager_user_id.label` and `.help`, `.effective_from.help`, `.effective_to.help`, `.id.label`, `sys_business_unit_member.description`, `sys_business_unit_member.fields.is_primary.help` (7): `en` says business unit in each; es-ES now says "unidad de negocio", the term the bundle already uses for the object label and its `business_unit_id` labels. Right.
   Nothing is added beyond what `en` says, and nothing contradicting is left in the same objects.
3. Retired-term sweep of the three HEAD bundles (departamento and proyecto case-insensitive; 部門, プロジェクト; 部门, 项目) against `en` at the same path: the only carriers are `sys_business_unit.description` (kind examples) and `sys_business_unit.fields.kind.options.department`, and `en` carries "department" at both. 0 mismatches — the dev's "0 after" count holds.
4. The 13 / 12 / 13 candidates left as written: each read against `en`. All are cases where `en` added detail or reworded (the two `organization_id` helps, `client_secret`, `headers_json`, `sys_metadata_history.*`, `actor_id`, `sys_notification.label` / `.pluralLabel`). None asserts what `en` now denies. The two closest calls: `sys_email.fields.error.help` (the locales are narrower — transport error only — where `en` adds pre-delivery validation) and `sys_metadata_history.description` (locales still say audit trail; unlike `sys_job_run`, no source commit retired that word — `59261af32` keeps the audit framing). Both are stale-not-contradicting under the card's ruling. Right; a judgment call, recorded.
5. No companion or ledger change: consistent with the tooling as the dev measured it — the source-hashes companions record byte copies of `en` only, and a hand translation that differs from `en` is not a recorded fill. The head's own `check:i18n` and `check:i18n-stale-fill` verdicts belong to Lint and Repo Gates, in_progress at read.
6. The dev's acceptance note on `bu-rename-consistency.test.ts`: verified on `origin/main` line 22 — es-ES is spelled as the case-sensitive `/Departamento/`, so the two lowercase labels passed a test whose header says it asserts every field label. True.
7. The source commits the PR body cites (`ca19ee81f`, `266654d82`, `61ed5c7c9`, `e16f2a830`, `7bb92056e`, `59261af32`) exist in history and their subjects say what the PR body says of them.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/20539-stale-authored-object-leaves.md` declares `@objectstack/platform-objects` `patch`. The package publishes (no `private`, `publishConfig.access: public`, currently 17.5.0), and a bug fix in a released package takes `patch` — right; not `skip-changeset`, and no `minor` is owed because nothing an author can write changes. `Clause-②: no`, in the PR body and in the changeset body, with no arm — right for a values-only translation diff. `Check Changeset` is success on the head.

Each factual sentence of the changeset: (a) an authored leaf is kept as written when its `en` source moves — true (the bundle header, quoted on the card). (b) on a ja-JP, es-ES or zh-CN console the `sys_two_factor` record page described `backup_codes` as JSON-serialized where `en` says one opaque ciphertext, not readable JSON — true (the old values in the diff; `en` on `origin/main`). (c) nineteen leaves — 4 + 11 + 4 = 19 value changes in the diff, true. (d) the four keys re-translated in all three locales and what each now says — true. (e) "es-ES only: seven `sys_business_unit` / `sys_business_unit_member` labels and help texts" — the count and the substance are true; the kind is imprecise: 2 labels, 4 help texts and 1 description (`sys_business_unit_member.description`). A nit — the headline line already names descriptions — not a blocker. (f) leaves whose `en` only gained detail or was reworded are unchanged — true. (g) values only, no key added or removed, no provenance table changes — true on the file list. The title's `(#20539)` follows the package's own CHANGELOG convention.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: none.

1. Two es-ES labels found by a retired-term scan outside the card's named instrument — ANSWERED, in scope. The ruling is "re-translate the leaves whose meaning now contradicts `en`"; the since-last-edit diff was the suggested instrument, not the boundary of the set. Both labels contradict `en` today, sit in the same file, are values only, and are inside the Claim's file surface. Accepted.
2. Stale-but-not-contradicting leaves left as written — ANSWERED, this is what the ruling asks; the 13 / 12 / 13 are listed in the PR body with what `en` did. Accepted (①.4).
3. No companion or ledger changed — ANSWERED. The Claim allowed those files only where the regenerator requires it, and the dev's measurement says it requires nothing here. Accepted; the at-head gate family is in Lint and Repo Gates, in_progress at read.
4. Shared clone unshallowed — ANSWERED, a local-environment effect on the dev's clone with no file in the diff. Noted; no repo effect.
5. Out-of-scope finding a (plugin-webhooks `sys_webhook.fields.definition_json.help` contradicting `en` on a security field in all three locales; plugin-audit `sys_activity.fields.environment_id.label` still saying Project; the metadata-forms `permission` and `agent` section descriptions promising what `en` dropped) — ESCALATED to the seat: file the one family card the dev proposed. Not for this PR; outside its file surface.
6. Out-of-scope finding b (`bu-rename-consistency.test.ts` case-sensitive es-ES regex, "carrier: none") — ESCALATED to the seat as a decision: the guard gap is dormant now that the values are fixed; a one-token case-insensitive spelling would close it. Fold into the family card or leave it. Not a blocker for this head.
7. The other listed deviations (a `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` re-run after building nine packages, the model-free commit trailer, measurement scripts kept in the scratchpad) are process notes with nothing in the diff.
